video_title: Trade made under duress? 👀 Windhorst questions timing of Jaylen Brown to 76ers | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics fans and analysts question the Jaylen Brown trade logic
quotes.excerpt: Celtics fans do not understand this trade at all.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: Celtics fans do not understand this trade at all, Brian Windhorst. Jaylen Brown, Paul George, some draft picks. They don't understand it. I have said Brad Stevens should run for president, not run an NBA team. He is that smart. This doesn't seem smart. Explain this to me.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Other teams in the league felt like this looked like a trade that was made under duress, that you wouldn't make this trade if everything was equal. I look forward to hearing an explanation from the Celtics side because I cannot explain it on its face.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Questioning the urgency of the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: There is no reason to feel any pressure to make this move on July 1st.
quotes.quote: Even if they wanted to move on from Jaylen Brown and even if they didn't like the offers that they had today, it doesn't make sense why this trade would have to happen now. Even if you believe that Jaylen Brown had played his last game for you, there is no reason to feel any pressure to make this move on July 1st. I promise you that there would have been other opportunities. And not only that, to make it to a team that is in your conference, in your division, a team that just vanquished you in the playoffs, the more you look at it, the more mystifying it gets.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of Jaylen Brown and Paul George on Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: This absolutely improved the Sixers, move them up the ranks.
quotes.quote: This is definitely an upgrade for them because Jaylen Brown has been very healthy. Paul George has been not healthy there and of course this last year he got suspended. You are getting a player who can defend the perimeter. If you play the Celtics in the playoffs again, Jaylen Brown is going to be your defender on Jason Tatum. One of the big things you have to solve in the Eastern Conference is how do you guard these superior wings like Donovan Mitchell, like Jaylen Brunson, like Jason Tatum. They traded for that player. Plus your guards are ascending, BJ Boston and Tyrese Maxey are ascending. They are a power backcourt. This absolutely improved the Sixers, move them up the ranks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' free agency and lack of team progress
quotes.excerpt: There has not been much back and forth.
quotes.quote: You are asking a very good question. I wish I had a good answer for you. So do the teams that want to recruit him because to this point, there has not been much back and forth. The teams have expressed interest, but there has not been traction going forward on what a process might be, whether there will be a meeting or whether they will be given an opportunity to formally show how they feel like LeBron can fit. LeBron went back to the golf course today.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' unique free agency flexibility
quotes.excerpt: LeBron has more information today than he did yesterday, which is that Jaylen Brown has been traded.
quotes.quote: The thing about this that is different from his previous free agencies is that these teams don't have to hold cap space for him. Because he is willing to play for less money, the teams can proceed with their business. He will just be a value add. So that gives LeBron the opportunity to sit back and wait and watch things. LeBron has more information today than he did yesterday, which is that Jaylen Brown has been traded to the Sixers. So maybe after the holiday, we will see things start to go, but the teams don't even have a sense of a timeline yet.
